motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council request the City Attorney, with the assistance from the Library Department, to prepare and present an Ordinance that would amend Los Angeles Administrative Code Section 10.5 (a) to add Library publishing agreements to the list of specific exceptions from this Section, for a term not to exceed the term of copyright and any extensions and renewals thereof. PRESENTED BY: SECONDED BY: F lbwdakaa—Z MONICA RODRIGUEZ O V 24 Councilwoman, 7th District MM MAR 2 5 2026
title: Library Publishing Agreements / Exceptions / Los Angeles Administrative Code (LAAC) Section 10.5 / Ordinance Amendment
